title: cmux signal sources
description: Every signal source an app can read with cmux.watch(name, params). One entry per source: what it reads, which events push a re-read, and how fast the runtime may poll behind it. tools/gen-cmux-global.ts turns this file into generated/signals.json (the runtime's table) and the typed cmux.watch overloads in generated/cmux-app.d.ts.

jsonSchema.description: A JSON Schema (the subset tools/json-schema.ts checks). In a value schema, {"$ref": "cmux:types/<Name>"} names a catalog type (Cmux.<Name> in the d.ts).

scopes.description: The scopes that let an app read this source: holding any one of them is enough. The runtime checks the read ops locally (scope.missing); the host checks every call.

read.description: How the runtime reads the source. `op`: one catalog or host op, called with the watch params as they are. `reader`: a named reader in js/src/signal-readers.ts that calls only the ops listed in `ops` (in order: the first that works).

push.description: Event streams (cmux.events.on names) that mean the source changed. Each one triggers a coalesced re-read. Empty when nothing pushes yet: the runtime then polls.

pollFloorSeconds.description: The fastest the runtime may poll this source (a reader's everySeconds is clamped up to it, and error backoff starts at it).

staleAfterSeconds.description: How old a value may be before it is re-read: the poll interval when nothing pushes, and the age past which a remount re-reads a cached value.
